==About==

Crafting a {{i|Ghost Loaf}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Ghost Loaf}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Ghost Loaf. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
